messages:
Priya Rao: Quick heads-up — NovaHealth accepted our preview slot for Redwood Dedicated. Start date target: next Monday. Need to triage onboarding owners and risk flags. Finance already noted renewal sensitivity after 8 weeks if they're not live.

onboard-bot: NovaHealth added to Preview program. Assigned CSM: Priya Rao. Please run onboarding checklist.

Devin Brooks: I can take infra + staging. Will need SCIM/SAML details and a sample redacted dataset. ETA to staging creds: 48h after we get the files.

Hana Lee: I'll own support handoff and run the enablement playbook. I'll prepare a short runtime FAQ and a 'how to check logs' doc.

Priya Rao: Thanks. Can someone draft the kickoff agenda? Keep it tight: intros (10), infra & SSO (20), sample ingest demo (15), metrics & milestones (15).

Marco Ruiz: From product: we'll want to see their typical prompt distribution and a couple of production prompts to run evals. We'll also schedule a short product check at week 3 to capture blocking UX issues.

Priya Rao: Action items: 
- Devin: request CSV + SAML metadata from NovaHealth POC (sarah@novahealth.io).
- Hana: enablement doc + link to short survey.
- Marco: prepare eval checklist and A/B profile to test.
I'll send invites and a shared tracker.

Devin Brooks: Sent the sample request to Sarah, asked for an anonymized dump + expected qps and median prompt length. Also asked for the contact for their infra (cc'd engineering).

finance-bot: Note: account flagged as renewal-sensitive. If onboarding extends past 8 weeks, escalate to Renewals team.

Hana Lee: Survey link prepared: https://forms.gle/novafeedback — short (6 Qs) focusing on latency, reliability, and dev ergonomics. Will add it to the week-2 and week-4 follow-ups.

Priya Rao: If any blocker appears that will delay >3 business days, open a GH issue with label `preview/novahealth` and severity tag (P0/P1). I'll monitor and notify Renewals if severity is P0.

Devin Brooks: Quick note on token/cost estimates: ask them for avg prompt tokens and expected monthly qps. I'll provide a cost estimate template pre-kick.

Marco Ruiz: Scheduling: propose Wed 09:00 PST for a 60m kickoff + 30m optional deep-dive for arch questions. 

Priya Rao: Wed 09:00 PST works — invites out. Please add any pre-kick artifacts to the shared drive: SAML metadata, sample dataset, engineering POC, perf expectations.

Devin Brooks: Prep checklist posted in invite:
- SAML metadata file (xml)
- SCIM admin creds (or invite)
- Sample dataset (CSV, <= 50MB)
- Expected qps and avg prompt tokens
- Network allowlist entries

Priya Rao: Great. Post-kick, we'll run a two-week health check (ops + product) and collect the survey. If we see major perf regressions, product will open a triage ticket.

Marco Ruiz: I'll prepare a minimal eval harness to run on their sample data and share results within 5 days after kick.

Hana Lee: I'll host a 20-min enablement walkthrough in the first week and drop a recording.

Priya Rao: Thanks team. One last ask — Sarah, can you confirm timeline constraints on your side? If they have a hard go-live window we should capture it in the tracker.

onboard-bot: Reminder: label GitHub issues with `preview/novahealth`. Morning digest will surface P0s.

Priya Rao: Closing loop: all pre-kick items due EOD before the kickoff. I'll send a short summary to NovaHealth after the call and schedule week-2/4 check-ins. :white_check_mark:
